name: warden
description: Keeps watch over every reply and stops Claude from racing on ad-hoc work. Injects a methodical-mode checklist before each response (Restate, Verified/Unverified assumptions, Read Floor, Approach Deliberation, Blast Radius, Stall Check, Competing Hypotheses, Goal-Driven Execution, See It Through, Observation Grounding). A Stop hook enforces five gates: a file:line citation verifier, an uncertainty-tell scanner, a Fable-mode completion gate (blocks replies that end by promising work instead of doing it), a zero-tool-call grounding audit, and a two-tier critic dialog (Haiku fast-critic rounds 1-3, Opus pre-stop-critic rounds 4-6, hard block at round 6 until /warden:trust-me). Each critic runs a 10-item rule audit and checks that the prior round's flags were addressed. /warden:casual skips one turn, /warden:trust-me bypasses strict gates for one turn, /warden:fable-off disables the completion gate, /warden:off disables it until /warden:on and persists across restarts. /warden:deep for heavier analysis, /warden:second-opinion for an independent critique.
